segments.text: Yuki's schoolmate from a neighbouring class, Zakuro, is the protagonist of the "Looking-glass Insects" chapter. She has a tendency to get lost in her thoughts and frequently spaces out. Due to her timid and soft-spoken nature,
she is often a target of tasteless pranks and bullying
. She considers her classmate Kimika to be her only friend, though their relationship appears to be occasionally ambiguous.
Edited from Wikipedia
第三の視点者。
すべての事件の震源地であり、終ノ空世界の始まりの少女である。
故事“Looking-glass Insects”的主人公。
因为她的决定让世界分裂为数条道路。
「这可是自己的意志啊……并不是随波逐流，而是认真思考的结果啊。希実香」
原画：基4%

segments.text: Yuki's classmate, Takuji, is the protagonist of "It's My Own Invention" chapter. He is a reclusive boy from an otaku subculture who's always stammering while speaking with others. Takuji rarely attends class as he spends most of his time secluded in his secret hideout that he had constructed under the school’s old drained swimming pool.
His personality will go through a profound transformation after the death of Takashima Zakuro.
Edited from Wikipedia
最後の視点者。
終ノ空世界における中心的存在。
彼が導く世界の先に、その空は存在する。
故事“It's my own Invention”的主人公。
看着世界的先定和谐。
「失败？你在说些什么呢……这可是必然的啊……这可是先定和谐啊……」
原画：基4%
一にして全。

segments.text: テレビアニメに出てくる魔法少女。
間宮卓司によって具現化する。
ケロQによるゲーム『終ノ空』及び『素晴らしき日々』の登場キャラクター。
可愛らしさを強調した衣装に身を包んだ少女。
容姿は間宮卓司の好きな漫画に登場する魔法少女に酷似しており、世界終末の日『終の空』に人々を導いていく。
存在自体が謎に包まれており、そもそも実在する人間なのか、『終の空』の狂気に取りつかれた人間による妄想の中の少女なのかも不明。
『終の空』が近づくにつれ、存在感を強めていくことになる。
そう、わたし、魔法少女リルルよ
原画：基4%
若槻琴美を慕っている。
剣道部の後輩であるが、彼女にはまったく違った側面があった。
行人的同班同学的妹妹。
和琴美一样是剑道部成员，憧憬琴美。
她接触到疯狂的时候，她对琴美的感情转变成对琴美的疯狂。

Tomosane is the protagonist of the "Jabberwocky I & II" chapters. He is considered to be the strongest fist-fighter in the school and he rules over its most unsavory elements by fear. Tomosane is also a source of dread for Takuji, whom he brutalizes and extorts money from frequently. Other than that,
he works part-time as a piano player at a transvestite bar, and has a tumultuous friendship with Minakami Yuki
. His secret hobby is playing retro video games.
Edited from Wikipedia
Takuji's younger sister, Hasaki, is the protagonist of the "Which Dreamed It" chapter. She's a shy and timorous girl, who carries a stuffed rabbit doll around with her everywhere she goes.

Hasaki is very attached to her older brother and often visits him at his school, though she doesn't attend the said school herself. She works at the same bar as Tomosane by helping out and cooking in the kitchen.
Edited from Wikipedia

Kimika is Zakuro's classmate and her closest friend, though she considers that she betrayed their friendship and because of that she often treats her coldly in an attempt to alienate her. Kimika's an explosive girl who dabbles in chemical science and it's no surprise she became a 39th president of the Kita High Science Club. She also joined the Track and Field Club in order to improve her poor reflexes.
Just like Zakuro, she is also the frequent target of bullying. After Zakuro's death, she'll become one of the most devoted followers of Takuji.
Edited from Wikipedia and Kickstarter page

Yuki is the protagonist of the "Down the Rabbit-Hole I & II" chapters. She is a habitual truant with a taste for cigarettes who considers herself antisocial, but in fact has an aptitude for getting along with other girls (and for intimidating boys as well). Besides that, Yuki is a fan of classical literature and she spends much of her time reading on the school's rooftop. As a result of her grandfather's stewardship of a kobudo dojo, she became skilled in ancient form of martial arts.
Edited from Wikipedia

Yuki's childhood friend, Tsukasa, is a gentle girl who acts as the mediator between Yuki and Tsukasa's older twin sister, Kagami. Also, Tsukasa is a member of the school's disciplinary committee and she is a fan of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
Edited from Wikipedia
Kagami is Yuki's childhood friend that acts as a stereotypical tsundere. She frequently argues with Takuji in school as well and is fiercely protective of her younger twin sister Tsukasa.
Edited from Wikipedia

Tomosane is the older brother of Takuji (real Takuji's body) and Hasaki. He took on the original Takuji's personality after Takuji's death seven years before the beginning of the story. After killing his brother, Tomosane's real personality was all but totally erased, only to resurface again 6 years later in the form of a new personality, Yuuki Tomosane. Tomosane later regains control of his body.
A classmate of Zakuro. She is cunning and sly.
Her family is apparently quite wealthy, and she receives an allowance of 300,000 yen every month.
Edited from Wikipedia
A girl in Yuki's class and a member of the science club with Kimika. She's also friends with Ayana.
A classmate of Zakuro. She is a former leader of a motorcycle gang.
She is a large woman and has studied karate since childhood, so she has strong arms and is feared by the boys. She is violent, but more decent than Megu.
Edited from Wikipedia
A homeroom teacher at Kita high.
The bar owner is a cross-dresser and a master of ancient martial arts.
A teacher at Kita High. Oversees the astrology club.
A student who bullies Mamiya Takuji. Megu's boyfriend.
The history teacher of Yuki, Kagami, and Tsukasa.
